```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
set.seed(8105)

data("ny_noaa")

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(id == "USW00094728") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(substr(date, 1, 4)),
    month = as.integer(substr(date, 6, 7)),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax),
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin),
    tmax = if_else(tmax == 9999, NA_real_, tmax) / 10,
    tmin = if_else(tmin == 9999, NA_real_, tmin) / 10,
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2010)

monthly_temp =
  weather_df |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarise(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(avg_tmax))
```

### Average maximum temperature by month and year

```{r heatmap}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_temp,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~year,
  z = ~avg_tmax,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorbar = list(title = "°C")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month", tickmode = "linear", dtick = 1),
    yaxis = list(title = "Year", tickmode = "linear", dtick = 1)
  )
```

### Maximum temperature by season

```{r boxplot}
plot_ly(
  data = weather_df |> filter(!is.na(tmax)),
  x = ~season,
  y = ~tmax,
  color = ~season,
  type = "box",
  boxpoints = FALSE
) |>
  layout(
    showlegend = FALSE,
    xaxis = list(title = "Season"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Daily maximum vs. minimum temperature

```{r scatter}
plot_ly(
  data = weather_df |>
    filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |>
    slice_sample(n = 500),
  x = ~tmin,
  y = ~tmax,
  color = ~season,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.6)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```
